# Independent adversarial review checklist

- [ ] Identity, posture, charge, burden, remedy and decision-maker are correct and verified.
- [ ] Evidence: item hash/path/locator preserved; quote checked against original; content classification is correct.
- [ ] The strongest admissible prosecution evidence, including evidence harmful to the defense, is accurately presented.
- [ ] Each defense sentence either rests on pinned evidence or is explicitly attributed as contention or inference.
- [ ] Each key causal chain states the warrant, alternative, missing premise, falsifier and proof request.
- [ ] Every contradiction distinguishes ordinary imprecision, changed account, material conflict and proven lie.
- [ ] Allegations about State actor knowledge and intent distinguish what was known then from information obtained later.
- [ ] Physical mechanics and trauma inferences are not declared medically or physically impossible without competent support.
- [ ] Probable cause, suppression, sufficiency, credibility, prejudice and remedy use separate applicable legal standards.
- [ ] Authority, adverse authority, citation text and currency independently checked against primary sources.
- [ ] Forensic-defense-frames F1–F7 scan passed when relevant; F6 warnings resolved.
- [ ] For court-facing work, quote verifier, Playbook Stage A and remaining required stages, local-rule/deadline, ethics and QC checks complete.
- [ ] No script PASS is presented as attorney approval. Reviewer identity and version hash recorded.
